head.h1: Valentines Day Catering in Dubai — Prices, Menus and Whether It Beats a Restaurant

opening_paragraph: Valentines day catering in Dubai from myCHEF is a private, plated dinner cooked in your own kitchen — AED 700 to AED 950 per person for a chef who shops, cooks every course on site, serves it and leaves the kitchen clean. For a bigger Valentine's gathering the same team delivers a buffet from AED 120 per person, or canapés, a grazing table and live stations from AED 150 per person, for ten guests or more. It is the alternative to a restaurant table on the busiest dining night of the year, and every figure on this page is a published rate, not a number that appears only after you enquire.

replace_in_block.new_heading: Valentine's Day food ideas for a party
new_paragraphs: If the plan is a room full of couples and not a table for two, the plated format is the wrong tool and the wrong price. Four things work reliably. A grazing table — cheese, charcuterie, figs, honey, warm bread — that people return to all evening and that needs no serving time. Canapés passed for the first hour while the room fills, which solves the awkward early stretch. A single live station the room can gather around, so there is something to watch and talk over. And a dessert table built around chocolate, which on this particular night does more conversational work than any main course.

These are priced as food formats, from AED 120 per person for a buffet and from AED 150 per person for canapés, grazing and live stations, with a minimum of 10 guests, or 20 for a buffet. For a seated group of eight to twenty who want the full plated treatment, the private chef rate applies instead. Either way one team owns the cooking, the service, the setup and the clean-up, so the host is not the person in the kitchen. See party catering for the wider version of this.

replace_in_block.new_heading: Valentines day catering in Dubai — common questions
new_paragraphs: Are restaurants more expensive on Valentine's Day?

We do not set restaurant prices and we have not audited them, so we will not print a figure we cannot stand behind. Ask the venue three things before you compare: is 14 February à la carte or a fixed set menu, is there a minimum spend or a prepaid deposit, and how long is the table yours. On our side the inputs are guest count, menu and service level — the date is not one of them, so a plated dinner at home is quoted from the same AED 700 to AED 950 per person range on 14 February as in June, plus 5% VAT.
Where should I go for Valentine's Day in Dubai?

MyCHEF does not run a restaurant, so this is not a venue list. What we cover is the other option: your own apartment or villa, a villa you have rented for the weekend, a yacht, a rooftop or a garden anywhere in Dubai. The chef travels to you. If what you want is a dining room with a view of the city, book that restaurant direct — it is a genuinely different evening.
Who pays for dinner on Valentine's Day?

There is no rule and we are not going to invent one. Practically: one booking produces one itemised quote and one invoice, addressed to whoever sends us the brief. We do not bill guests individually, so if several couples are sharing a table, one person books and settles up with the others privately.
How much does valentines day catering cost in Dubai?

A private chef cooking and serving a plated dinner is AED 700 to AED 950 per person, with no minimum headcount — a table for two is a normal booking. A party spread is priced as a food format instead: an event buffet from AED 120 per person for 20 guests or more, canapés, grazing and live stations from AED 150 per person for 10 guests or more, with a minimum order value of AED 900. A tasting menu with pairings runs from AED 1,400 per person. VAT of 5% is added to the total.
What are some Valentine's Day food ideas for a party?

For a group, the formats that work are a grazing table people graze at all evening, canapés passed for the first hour while the room fills, one live station the room can gather around, and a dessert table built around chocolate. All three are priced per head from AED 120 to AED 150, not at the plated private chef rate.
When is Valentine's Day and how far ahead should I book?

Valentine's Day is 14 February. It fell on a Saturday in 2026; the next one is Sunday 14 February 2027. Our published notice periods are about 2 weeks off-peak and 6 weeks between November and March. 14 February sits inside that peak window, so plan on the 6-week figure for a specific chef or a large table.
Is there a minimum number of guests?
Not for a plated private chef dinner — two guests is a normal booking. For the volume formats the minimum is 10 guests, rising to 20 guests for a buffet, with a minimum order value of AED 900.
Can you cater a Valentines dinner for two at home?
Yes, and it is the most common version of this booking. A chef shops, cooks each course in your kitchen, serves it, and clears everything away, so nobody at the table is running the evening.
Do you offer halal and dietary-specific menus?
Yes. Halal, vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free and nut-free menus are all catered, and every allergy is confirmed in writing before the date, not on the night.
Which areas of Dubai do you cover?
All of Dubai, including Downtown, Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah, Business Bay and Emirates Hills. The chef travels to your home, your villa or your yacht.
Request a Valentine's dinner proposal or chat on WhatsApp . Still comparing? Read the Dubai catering price guide , or look at the romantic dinner and date night pages.

add_block.new_heading: Restaurant or dinner at home on 14 February?
new_paragraphs: Most people searching around Valentine's Day in Dubai are looking for somewhere to go: a set menu, an offer, a view. So let us be straight about what this page is. We do not operate a venue, and this is not a list of restaurants. It is the case for the other option, made with the numbers visible so you can weigh it yourself.

What you buy at a restaurant on 14 February is a room, a fixed sitting and someone else's timing. Two seatings are common on that night, which means the table is yours for a set window and the last course tends to arrive at the pace of the kitchen, not the pace of your evening. What you buy at home is the opposite: your own room, your own music, your own timing, and no drive, no parking, no dressing for anyone. The chef arrives, sets up quietly, works to a schedule you agreed in advance, and leaves the kitchen as it was found.

The restaurant genuinely wins in one case: when going out is the occasion — the skyline, the walk, the being-among-people of it. If that is the evening you want, book it direct and enjoy it. Where a chef at home wins is when the point is the food, the privacy and not being rushed, or when the guest list is bigger than two and a table for eight on the fourteenth is already gone everywhere you have called.

add_block.new_heading: Are restaurants more expensive on Valentine's Day?
new_paragraphs: We are not going to print a restaurant price here. We do not set them and we have not audited them, so any figure would be a guess dressed up as research, and that is exactly the kind of number this site is trying to get rid of.

What we can give you is a way to check. Before you compare anything, ask the venue three questions: is 14 February à la carte or a fixed set menu, is there a minimum spend or a prepaid, non-refundable deposit, and how long is the table yours before the next sitting? Those three answers, not the headline price, decide what the evening costs in full. A set menu with a minimum spend and a two-hour table is a different product from a normal Tuesday booking at the same restaurant, whatever the per-head number says.

On our side the inputs are guest count, menu and service level. The calendar date is not one of them, so a plated dinner at home is quoted from the same AED 700 to AED 950 per person range on Valentine's Day as it is in June. What changes on 14 February is availability, not the rate: fewer chefs are free, so the constraint is the diary. And it is worth knowing what the rest of the market does here — two of the most visible catering names in Dubai, Cedar Tree Catering and Baguette, publish no per-head prices at all and quote only on request. Printing ours is a deliberate choice, so you can compare before you talk to anyone.

add_block.new_heading: What valentines day catering costs in Dubai — the two bands
new_paragraphs: There is no single price, because there are two different products. One is a chef cooking in front of you; the other is food arriving well presented. The table below is the whole picture.
What you are booking Who serves it Minimum Per person
Plated private chef dinner Chef cooks and serves at your table None — two guests is normal AED 700–950
Tasting menu with pairings Chef plus service None From AED 1,400
Event buffet or family-style Delivered and set up; staff optional 20 guests From AED 120
Canapés, grazing table, live stations Staffed on site 10 guests From AED 150

The gap between AED 150 and AED 700 is not a quality gap; it is a labour gap. At the lower end you are paying for the food and the setup. At the upper end you are paying for a chef whose whole evening is your evening — cooking each course to order, plating in your kitchen and pacing the meal to the table. Our set Date Night package starts from AED 1,200 if you would rather book a fixed thing than build one. The minimum order value across the volume formats is AED 900, and 5% VAT is added to every total.

add_block.new_heading: What is included, and what is not
new_paragraphs: Included: menu design with the chef, ingredient sourcing, cooking on site, plating and service, all cooking equipment, setup before guests arrive, full cleanup afterwards, and one person coordinating the whole thing from first enquiry to final clear-down. For a larger table, service staff and a floor lead can be added so drinks are poured and plates cleared without a guest leaving the table.

Not included: alcohol, which stays yours to supply unless it is agreed separately; flowers, unless we are coordinating with your florist; and anything that is not written on the proposal. The 5% VAT is added on top, not absorbed. Because it is a full-service format, not a drop-off, the quote is itemised line by line — nothing is added on the night.

add_block.new_heading: Why book myCHEF for a Valentine's dinner
new_paragraphs: MyCHEF was founded by a chef on one idea: you own the evening, we carry the work. No chef joins the network before clearing identity checks, a practical cooking assessment, reference verification and ongoing performance reviews — a continuous standard, not a one-time tick, set out in full on how we vet our chefs . We are honest about the limits of that: no system removes every risk, so each event is matched to the chef best suited to it.

We are equally honest about proof. This page carries no reviews, no ratings and no awards, because inventing them is both against Google's policy and against ours — when we have verified client feedback for this service, it will appear here and not before. What we can point at now is the vetting standard above, our, published prices you can check against the market, and the chefs themselves on our chefs . The kitchens and chefs handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

add_block.new_heading: Where to go for Valentine's Day in Dubai if you are not going out
new_paragraphs: The honest answer to "where" is that the venue becomes yours. A chef travels to an apartment in Downtown or Dubai Marina, a villa on Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah or Emirates Hills, a place in Business Bay, a villa rented for the weekend, a yacht, or a rooftop or garden if the weather is behaving — February usually is. All you need is a kitchen with working power, a table that seats your group, and somewhere for the chef to plate out of sight.

Two practical notes. If you are in a building with a service-entrance rule or a guest-parking limit, tell us when you book so the setup window works. And if you are hiring a villa for the night, check the kitchen before you sign, because holiday-home kitchens vary far more than the listing photographs suggest. Beyond that, browse the wider luxury dining experiences or our villa dining options to see where else this format is at home.
